review.why: Guide to blameless postmortems with a 5 Whys template, a quick template and a meeting facilitation plan.
review.summary: Explains blameless culture, when to write a postmortem, a one-week timeline, a 5 Whys template with evidence per step, a short template for minor incidents, a 60-minute meeting structure with facilitation tips, anti-patterns and do and don't lists. The full template library is in one reference file.
strengths: Quick postmortem template for minor incidents
